Saving 5,000,000 KRW in a year breaks down to roughly 417,000 KRW a month. That feels steep when money leaks out unnoticed, but your leak has a clear shape: frictionless spending. 

Start with one concrete move tonight. Audit your subscriptions and cancel anything you haven't opened this week. Next, remove your saved cards from food delivery apps. Adding even two minutes of friction between an impulse and checkout breaks the automatic habit. 

Finally, set up an automatic transfer for your monthly target the morning your paycheck lands, keeping that money out of reach before convenience takes its cut.
